title: Wendell and the Winter
author: Sable Winterbourne
blurb: Coral Hartwell, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the last resident signs the papers.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
